# Qt/PySide open-source license texts

PySide6 Essentials 6.11.3 and Shiboken6 metadata list the open-source choices
LGPL-3.0-only OR GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only. Their installed wheels supplied only
a commercial-license notice in the license directory, so distribution also
includes these verbatim standard license texts from the SPDX license-list-data
repository (text/LGPL-3.0-only.txt, text/GPL-2.0-only.txt, text/GPL-3.0-only.txt).

The portable app uses unchanged dynamically linked Qt/PySide libraries; those DLLs
remain replaceable. Do not impose restrictions on reverse engineering needed to
debug modifications of those libraries. Qt/PySide source for the matching release
is available from https://download.qt.io/official_releases/QtForPython/ and the
official Qt repositories. No Qt source modifications are included in this app.

Official package licensing: https://pypi.org/project/PySide6-Essentials/6.11.3/
License-text source: https://github.com/spdx/license-list-data/tree/main/text
Other dependency licenses/notices are collected from installed package metadata
into the portable folder's licenses directory. Model attribution stays with its
README and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt; the model is listed as Apache-2.0 by Vosk.
